title: 第3章 武者六阶三更求月票第4章 沉睡中的星相
content_zh:
;;
“蒋辰逸？”方羽呢喃自语。
作为武陵市本地人，又是武陵武道大专的学生，他自然听说过对方的名字……武道生高考状元和文化生高考状元可不同。
文化生高考状元，或许上的文化大学不错，但未来成就是很难说的，泯然众人的不在少数，所以，文化生状元，真正关注的人并不多。
可武道状元，情况完全不同的。
自古文无第一、武无第二。
武道高考，几乎没有取巧、运气一说，必须身体天赋、技艺悟性、虚空星相、战斗意识相乃至家庭背景等诸多方面都极为出众，才有可能成状元。
另一方面。
武道修炼，从16岁到25岁是成长最快的，也被称为‘黄金年龄段’，其次是25岁到30岁，被称为‘白银年龄段’。
能够在18岁左右成为市武道状元，武道天赋是一等一的，未来前途不可限量。
正因此。
任何一位武道生，若能成武道状元，都会成为绝对焦点，比文化生状元要耀眼十倍百倍，各路媒体记者、自媒体都会争抢报道……从双方得到的奖励都能看出来。
据方羽所知，文化生市状元，国家的直接奖励一般就数万星币到数十万星币，而武道市状元，国家奖励至少是数百万星币。
且这只是第一步，再往后，还会受到所在大学栽培，还可以提前签约大型武道集团，甚至成为一些品牌的代言人。
这是一条光明璀璨的路。
和蒋辰逸相比，像方羽这种大专武道生要黯淡太多了……哪怕他已是‘优秀大专生’。
“人比人，真是气死人。”许辰阳艳羡道：“这蒋辰逸，大一刚结束，就有这种实力，估计到大学毕业时，都有希望成大地武者了。”
方羽若有所思。
大焚天时代前，人类尚未迎来大进化，虚空星相未醒，武道修炼并非主流，只是以武道技艺划分出明劲武者、暗劲武者、化劲武者等等……可实际上，哪怕被誉为宗师高手的化劲武者，武道技艺虽高明，不亚于许多大地武者。
但限于环境，他们身体淬炼到极致，单臂拳力通常也就一两千公斤。

只论力量，都难及这个时代的中级武者。
直到大焚天时代后。
尤其是新历纪元以来的60年，武道飞速发展，在虚空星相加持下，武道通神，武者们拥有了匪夷所思的武力……最终，针对武者实力，又统一重新划分出武者六阶。
1-9级，属于普通人范畴。
10-19级，是一阶武者，又称初级武者，拳力标准最低300公斤。
20级-29级，是二阶武者，又称中级武者，拳力标准最低2000公斤。
30级-39级，是三阶武者，又称高级武者，拳力标准最低1万公斤。
40级-49级，四阶武者，被尊称大地武者，所拥有的超凡武力，已不能简单用拳力多少来形容，一些重型热武器都已对他们失效。
更高阶的五阶巡天武者、六阶星空武者，更是如神话走进人世间……已不是普通人能够想象了。
而大学毕业时，也才22岁左右。
成为大地武者？
对方羽这些大专生们而言，简直是天方夜谭……但放在蒋辰逸身上，却有可能。
毕竟，他这种迅速出拳，一拳都能超过六千公斤，若是全力以赴，恐怕都有七八千公斤的拳力，这也是许辰阳说他至少25级的缘故。
“前几天我和主管聊过，蒋辰逸在新月武道大学里，似乎都属于很一般的学生。”许辰阳低声感慨道：“真不知道，新月武道大学里面的顶尖本科生，会有多强。”

"Jiang Chenyi?" Fang Yu murmured to himself.
As a native of Wuling City and a student of Wuling Martial Arts College, he has naturally heard of the other party's name... The top scorer in the college entrance examination for martial arts students and the top scorer in the college entrance examination for cultural students are different.
The cultural students who get the top score in the college entrance examination may go to a good cultural university, but it is hard to say what their future achievements will be. There are many who are lost in the crowd. Therefore, not many people really pay attention to the cultural students who get the top score.
But the situation for the martial arts champion is completely different.
Since ancient times, there has been no first in literature and no second in martial arts.
In the martial arts college entrance examination, there is almost no trickery or luck. One must be extremely outstanding in many aspects such as physical talent, technical understanding, void astrology, fighting consciousness, and even family background, etc., in order to become the top scholar.
on the other hand.
In martial arts practice, the fastest growing period is from the age of 16 to 25, also known as the 'golden age group', followed by the age group of 25 to 30, known as the 'silver age group'.
Being able to become the city's martial arts champion at around the age of 18 means that his martial arts talent is first-rate and his future prospects are limitless.
That's why.
If any martial arts student becomes the top scholar in martial arts, he will become the absolute center of attention, ten times and a hundred times more dazzling than the top scholar in culture. Reporters from all media and self-media will compete for coverage... It can be seen from the rewards received by both parties.
As far as Fang Yu knows, the direct reward from the state for the number one scholar in the culture market is usually tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of star coins, while the reward from the state for the number one scholar in the martial arts market is at least millions of star coins.
And this is just the first step. In the future, you will be cultivated by your university, you can also sign with a large martial arts group in advance, and even become the spokesperson of some brands.
This is a bright and shining road.
Compared with Jiang Chenyi, a college martial arts student like Fang Yu is much bleak...even if he is already an 'outstanding college student'.
"Comparing people with each other is really irritating." Xu Chenyang said enviously: "Jiang Chenyi has such strength just after his freshman year. It is estimated that by the time he graduates from college, he will hopefully become an earth warrior."
Fang Yu was thoughtful.
Before the Great Fentian Era, human beings had not yet ushered in great evolution, the stars in the void had not yet awakened, and martial arts practice was not the mainstream. They were only divided into Ming Jin warriors, dark Jin warriors, Hua Jin warriors, etc. based on martial arts skills... But in fact, even the Hua Jin warriors who are known as masters, although their martial arts skills are excellent, are no less than those of many earth warriors.
However, due to the environment, their bodies are tempered to the extreme, and their single-arm punch strength is usually only one to two thousand kilograms.
In terms of strength, it is difficult to match the intermediate warriors of this era.
Until after the Great Burning Heaven era.
Especially in the 60 years since the New Calendar Era, martial arts have developed rapidly. With the blessing of the void stars, martial arts can communicate with gods, and warriors have incredible power... In the end, based on the strength of warriors, the sixth level of warriors was unified and reclassified.
Levels 1-9 belong to the category of ordinary people.
Levels 10-19 are first-level warriors, also known as junior warriors, with a minimum boxing strength standard of 300 kilograms.
Levels 20 to 29 are second-level warriors, also known as intermediate warriors, with a minimum boxing strength standard of 2,000 kilograms.
Levels 30-39 are third-level warriors, also known as advanced warriors, with a minimum boxing strength standard of 10,000 kilograms.
Level 40-49, fourth-level warriors, are honored as earth warriors. The extraordinary force they possess cannot be simply described in terms of punch strength. Some heavy thermal weapons have become ineffective against them.
The higher-level fifth-level sky patrol warriors and sixth-level starry sky warriors are like myths entering the human world... which is beyond the imagination of ordinary people.
When I graduated from college, I was only about 22 years old.
Become an earth warrior?
For college students like Fang Yu, this is simply a fantasy... but for Jiang Chenyi, it is possible.
After all, he can punch more than 6,000 kilograms with such rapid punches. If he goes all out, he may have a punch power of 7,000 to 8,000 kilograms. This is why Xu Chenyang said that he is at least level 25.
"A few days ago IAfter talking to the supervisor, Jiang Chenyi seemed to be an average student at Crescent Martial Arts University. "Xu Chenyang sighed in a low voice: "I really don't know how strong the top undergraduate students in Crescent Martial Arts University will be. "
